nodes.label: main.html MkDocs Template Override
nodes.rationale: Extends the Material base.html and overrides the content block to inject a styled page banner before super().

nodes.label: fo-page-banner
nodes.rationale: Rendered on every non-home content page with a title: a decorative faded watermark icon plus an inline icon from page.meta.icon, the parent section title (or site_name) as an eyebrow, and the page title as h1. Suppressed on the home page, detected by 'navigation' being in page.meta.hide.
